**Park the event-driver design and hold further paid work on the stopped lines.** I cannot name a bounded candidate on the present record whose result would move a quality gate at a justified cost. Keep the records and Alex’s page current, and return to the council if a concrete new angle emerges.

Two qualifications matter for D581:

- Park the design **until the quality path is clearer and the council reopens it**, not necessarily until after adoption. Integration is itself part of the work owed before replacement, even though this slice cannot pass a quality gate. [D548]( /Users/lchingen/hivemind/docs/DECISIONS-log.md:6721)
- The unresolved main-part procedure is **not established as a choice only Alex can make**. D439 permits the council to decide within his rules while he is away; the present problem is that no general, sourced candidate has survived review. Deck 1 and the role of the six lines remain in their recorded order for Alex. [D439]( /Users/lchingen/hivemind/docs/DECISIONS-log.md:4871), [D580]( /Users/lchingen/hivemind/docs/DECISIONS-log.md:7467)

One correction remains on the [planner result page]( /Users/lchingen/hivemind/docs/research/2026-11-14-use-acceptance/idea-planner/RESULT.md:32): it calls Ruled out “the opposite of Yes” and Still open “the absence of an outcome.” Still open is a third stored outcome, and Ruled out is not the whole complement of Yes. The page for Alex should also update the spending figure from its stale approximately $26.07 to the latest recorded approximately $26.18.

D543’s warning against opening narrow work that cannot change the path remains useful, but D544 withdrew its deferral of the system-direction choice. The new system remains the direction of work; the old system remains the default until the new one passes its gates. [D543–D544]( /Users/lchingen/hivemind/docs/DECISIONS-log.md:6589)

CONSENSUS: yes — park the design as recorded input, correct the two pages, and hold paid work and new lines until Alex returns or the council identifies a concrete gate-moving candidate.
